title: Scalar compatibility of point internal-Hom evaluation
statement:
Fix $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and finite extensions $E\subset L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in a fixed $\Qlb$ [def-pod-conventions]. Write $R=\mathcal O_E$, $R'=\mathcal O_L$, $B=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,s}$ and $B'=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{L,s}$. Let $P$ be a bounded complex of finite-projective $R$-modules [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], and put $K=B\otimes_{\underline R}\underline P$, $P^\vee=\operatorname{Hom}_R^\bullet(P,R)$ and $H=B\otimes_{\underline R}\underline{P^\vee}$. Assume $K,H$ are in $D^b_c(s,R)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] and identify $H$ with $R\mathcal Hom_B(K,B)$ by the ordinary finite-projective Hom-complex model [def-pur-derived-internal-hom, def-pur-hom-complex]. Use the integral scalar-extension functor $T_{L/E}$ and operation comparison of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension], with its internal-Hom arrow the transpose of scalar-extended evaluation. Identify $T_{L/E}$ with ordinary derived extension $-\otimes_B^L B'$ by the canonical completion comparison [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. The diagram comparing sections of the internal-Hom scalar arrow, through the specified sections comparisons [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension], with the coefficient-module arrow
$$P^\vee\otimes_R R'\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{R'}^\bullet(P\otimes_R R',R')$$
commutes in the derived category. The lower arrow is the actual map $f\otimes a\mapsto(x\otimes b\mapsto f(x)\otimes ab)$, with the two sides placed in the same signed Hom-complex convention. This commutative diagram is natural in maps of $P$, is the identity under the canonical identifications when $L=E$, and respects the specified associators for $E\subset L\subset M$. It remains commutative after rationalization to $E\subset L$, including naturality for localized morphisms.
